name: External Proxy Account Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external proxy account type code, as published in the proxy account type external code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

TELE.name: Telephone Number
TELE.definition: A telephone number in the format specified by the 'The international public telecommunication numbering plan ITU-T E.164.

EMAL.name: Email Address
EMAL.definition: Internationalised address of an electronic mail box for internet messages.

CINC.name: Certificate Of Incorporation Number
CINC.definition: Corporate Identification issued by a national  institution or regulator, used as account proxy. |(applied for corporate account proxy).

COTX.name: Corporate Tax Identification
COTX.definition: Unique government-issued tax Identification used as account proxy to identify the corporate (for example for government tax) and typically linked to the corporate bank account (applied for corporate account proxy).

COID.name: Country Authority Identification
COID.definition: Identification issued by a national  institution or regulator (different from a national scheme like a clearing provider), used as account proxy (applied for corporate or individual account proxy).

CUST.name: Customer Identification Number
CUST.definition: Any other customer identification number issued by a corporate, bank or other organization, used as account proxy.|(applied for corporate or individual account proxy).

DRLC.name: Driver License Number
DRLC.definition: Unique government-issued Identification used as account proxy to  identify the individual  (for example for government charges, road taxes and tolls,vaccination charges) and typically linked to the individual's bank account (applied for  individual account proxy).

EIDN.name: Electronic Identification
EIDN.definition: Government-issued Identification (different from a passport Identification or a national Identification). Used as account proxy to  identify the individual (for example for public benefits) and typically linked to the individual's bank account (applied for  individual account proxy).

EWAL.name: E Wallet Identification
EWAL.definition: Market-adopted prepaid instruments like e-Wallets, payments to / from e-wallets from / to bank accounts (applied for corporate or individual account proxy).

PVTX.name: Individual Tax Identification
PVTX.definition: Unique government-issued  tax Identification  used as account proxy to  identify the individual  for example for government tax) and typically linked to the individual's bank account (applied for  individual account proxy).

LEIC.name: Legal Entity Identifier Code
LEIC.definition: Legal Entity Identifier used as account proxy (applied for corporate account proxy).|Use cases: Can be used by corporates as a "government-issued" Identification for registration with payment schemes as a proxy. The proxy may be further used for payments and collections using the underlying instant payment rails for a variety of corporate use cases.

MBNO.name: Mobile Phone Number
MBNO.definition: Mobile phone number in the format specified by the “The international public telecommunication numbering plan ITU- T E 164" (applied for corporate or individual account proxy).

NIDN.name: National Identification Number
NIDN.definition: Unique government-issued Identification  used as account proxy to  identify the individual  or corporate for example for public benefits, government subsidies) and typically linked to the individual's / corporate bank account.|(applied for corporate or individual account proxy).

CCPT.name: Passport Number
CCPT.definition: Unique government-issued Identification  used as account proxy to  identify the individual  (for example for government charges, road taxes, vaccination charges) and typically linked to the individual's bank account|(applied for  individual account proxy).

SHID.name: Scheme Identification Number
SHID.definition: Account proxy issued by a payment scheme (applied for corporate or individual account proxy).|Use cases: Any proxies issued by clearing systems, for example VPA (India), FPS Identifier (Hong Kong), Jompay (Malaysia) CCIN (Canada).

SOSE.name: Social Security Number
SOSE.definition: Unique government-issued Identification  used as account proxy to identify the individual  (for example for public benefits) and typically linked to the individual's bank account (applied for individual account proxy).

TOKN.name: Token Identification
TOKN.definition: Electronic Identification used, for example, to mask an account number as a means of data secrecy.|(applied for corporate or individual account proxy).

UBIL.name: Utilities Subscription Identification
UBIL.definition: Subscriber Identification for utilities and services. As opposed to a biller Identification, this identification is used for the subscriber of the service (applied for corporate or individual account proxy).

VIPN.name: Vehicle Identification Plate Number
VIPN.definition: Account proxy for receiving insurance claims, pay insurance premium, road tax payments, traffic tickets etc.(applied for corporate or individual account proxy).

BIID.name: Biller Subscriber Identification
BIID.definition: Billers of specific utilities could register for a Biller Identification as supported in the clearing scheme, and use this identification for collections (applied for corporate account proxy).

OSID.name: Other Scheme Identification Number
OSID.definition: Additional scheme identifier used to complement the primary scheme identification so that banks can apply respective validations of the proxy value as per the Type code provided.
